$comment: The ordered inventory of every PeerSlate schema migration this repository knows about.
Order is apply order. A prerequisite always appears above the migration that requires it.
This file deliberately records NO claim about what any database carries. Applied-ness is a
property of a database, read live from dbo.schema_migrations by scripts/govern_sql_migrations.py
and written to docs/governance/PRODUCTION_SCHEMA_STATE.md. A file that asserts applied-ness drifts;
this one cannot, because it never makes the claim.
gate: null means the migration has never been proven against a throwaway database under this path.
The applier refuses to apply it. Produce a proof with `govern_sql_migrations.py gate`.

migrations.summary: Additive account-export job/domain ledger (C1 of the Settings account-export program, PS-SETTINGS-ACCOUNT-EXPORT-FOUNDATION-001): dbo.account_export_jobs and dbo.account_export_job_domains store request/artifact state, timestamps, counts, byte sizes, and hashes, never exported member content. Three owner-scoped procedures (request/status/download-metadata) accept only a trusted server-derived user key and resolve app_users.id to the active member_profiles.profile_id internally. Worker procedures claim/complete/fail are fenced by compare-and-set lease token and attempt; expire/cleanup are deliberately unfenced system-wide sweeps. Together they enforce one active job per owner across queued/running/ready-before-expiry, one request per owner per 24 hours, and a three-attempt cap. No domain-reader procedure is created (no V1 domain has an approved field allowlist yet); no container, workload identity, scheduler, or production apply is authorized by this migration.

Read-only owner-scoped account-export core readers (replacement package 1 of the 2026-08-29 reader topology, after PS-SETTINGS-ACCOUNT-EXPORT-DOMAIN-READERS-001 failed independent pre-activation review): usp_ReadAccountExportAccountForOwner, usp_ReadAccountExportProfileForOwner, and one reader per PS-PLAT-006 Living Resume table (career_chapters/_experiences/_education/_credentials/_projects/_achievements/_skills/_timeline_events) -- ten procedures total, each accepting only @UserKey, resolving identity internally, and returning a read window as trailing columns on its single INSERT-EXEC-safe result set. career_skill_links is deliberately excluded pending an evidence-disclosure decision. No table, trigger, index, container, worker, route, or UI change.

Read-only owner-scoped account-export Capture/Moment readers (replacement package 2, 2026-08-29 topology): six @UserKey-only procedures over captures, capture_revisions, moments, moment_versions, moment_sources, and moment_placements, each with an exact text-truth allowlist, owner predicate, deterministic order, and trailing read-window columns. target_entity_id/dbo.slate_entities (Opportunity Slate) deliberately excluded; no table, trigger, index, container, worker, route, or UI change.

Read-only owner-scoped account-export Workshop/My Knowledge readers (replacement package 3, 2026-08-29 topology): two @UserKey-only procedures over knowledge_items and knowledge_item_versions, each with an exact text-truth allowlist, an owner predicate (both-sided on the versions reader, which independently carries its own owner_profile_id unlike the sibling packages' version-history tables), deterministic order, and trailing read-window columns. knowledge_item_save_requests deliberately excluded (idempotency machinery, not content); no table, trigger, index, container, worker, route, or UI change.

Read-only owner-scoped account-export Opportunity Slate readers (replacement package 4, the FINAL content reader of the 2026-08-29 topology): four @UserKey-only procedures over the durable saved slate only (opportunity_slates, opportunity_saved_results, opportunity_saved_qualifications, opportunity_saved_evidence). Directive-trimmed: hard-excludes third-party posting text, evidence links, responses, and every AI/model provenance field. Every OS-1/OS-2/OS-3 working-session table and all three PS-OPPSLATE-004 tables are ephemeral (cascade-purged with the working session) and deliberately not read.
